declarations.type:
∀ {a c : ℝ},
  RankTransport.Good a c →
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ (j : ℕ),
        0 < j →
          (↑j - 1) / √(RankTransport.p n) ≤ a →
            0 < RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n ∧
              RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n < c * RankTransport.H (RankTransport.p n)

RankTransport.GaussianCurve →
  RankTransport.SharpSparse →
    RankTransport.SharpFlat →
      ∀ {b eG eS eF : ℝ},
        0 ≤ b →
          0 < eG →
            0 < eS →
              0 < eF →
                ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                  ∀ (j : ℕ),
                    0 < j →
                      j ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ + 1 →
                        have r := (↑j - 1) / √(RankTransport.p n);
                        0 < RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n ∧
                          RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n <
                            Min.min (RankTransport.g r + eG)
                                (Min.min (RankTransport.sparseStar r + eS) (RankTransport.flatStar r + eF)) *
                              RankTransport.H (RankTransport.p n)
∀ (n j : ℕ) {b : ℝ}, 0 < j → j ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ + 1 → ¬j - 1 ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ → False
∀ (r : ℝ), RankTransport.sparseStar r = (RankTransport.As + RankTransport.Ks * r) / RankTransport.Ds

∀ (n j : ℕ) {y : ℝ},
  RankTransport.p n ≤ y →
    j + 1 ≤ RankTransport.piLE y - RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) → RankTransport.p (n + j) < y
∀ (n : ℕ) {c d : ℝ}, c ≤ d → RankTransport.count c (RankTransport.p n) ≤ RankTransport.count d (RankTransport.p n)
∀ (n j : ℕ) {y : ℝ}, ¬n + j < n + (j + 1) → False
∀ (n j : ℕ) {b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ b → 0 < j → j ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ + 1 → (↑j - 1) / √(RankTransport.p n) ∈ Set.Icc 0 b

∀ n < RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n),
  ¬n + 1 < RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) → ¬RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) = n + 1 → False
RankTransport.SharpSparse → ∀ {r e : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → 0 < e → RankTransport.Good r (RankTransport.sparseStar r + e)

RankTransport.GaussianCurve →
  RankTransport.SparseCurve →
    RankTransport.FlatCurve →
      ∀ {b e : ℝ},
        0 ≤ b →
          0 < e →
            ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              ∀ (j : ℕ),
                0 < j →
                  j ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ + 1 →
                    0 < RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n ∧
                      RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n <
                        (RankTransport.frontier ((↑j - 1) / √(RankTransport.p n)) + e) *
                          RankTransport.H (RankTransport.p n)

∀ (a : ℝ),
  RankTransport.frontier a = Min.min (RankTransport.g a) (Min.min (RankTransport.sparse a) (RankTransport.flat a))

∀ {a c d : ℝ},
  RankTransport.Good a c →
    RankTransport.Good a d →
      ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
        ∀ (j : ℕ),
          0 < j →
            (↑j - 1) / √(RankTransport.p n) ≤ a →
              0 < RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n ∧
                RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n < Min.min c d * RankTransport.H (RankTransport.p n)
∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ y → RankTransport.piLT y = RankTransport.piLE y - if ↑⌊y⌋₊ = y ∧ Nat.Prime ⌊y⌋₊ then 1 else 0
∀ {a c d : ℝ}, RankTransport.Good a c → RankTransport.Good a d → RankTransport.Good a (Min.min c d)
∀ (n j : ℕ) {y : ℝ}, 0 < j → ¬(j ≤ RankTransport.piLE y - (n + 1) ↔ n + j < RankTransport.piLE y) → False
∀ (n j : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 0 < j → ¬(j ≤ RankTransport.piLT y - (n + 1) ↔ n + j < RankTransport.piLT y) → False

∀ (n : ℕ) {y : ℝ},
  (¬(RankTransport.piLE y - if ↑⌊y⌋₊ = y ∧ Nat.Prime ⌊y⌋₊ then 1 else 0) - RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) =
        RankTransport.piLE y - RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) - if ↑⌊y⌋₊ = y ∧ Nat.Prime ⌊y⌋₊ then 1 else 0) →
    False

∀ {b : ℝ},
  0 ≤ b →
    ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      Continuous f →
        (∀ a ≥ 0, ∀ e > 0, RankTransport.Good a (f a + e)) →
          ∀ {e : ℝ},
            0 < e →
              ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (j : ℕ),
                  0 < j →
                    j ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ + 1 →
                      0 < RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n ∧
                        RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n <
                          (f ((↑j - 1) / √(RankTransport.p n)) + e) * RankTransport.H (RankTransport.p n)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (y : ℝ),
  0 < j → (j ≤ RankTransport.piLT y - RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) ↔ RankTransport.p (n + j) < y)

∀ (n j : ℕ) {y : ℝ},
  RankTransport.p n ≤ y →
    0 < j → (j ≤ RankTransport.piLE y - RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) ↔ RankTransport.p (n + j) ≤ y)
∀ (k : ℕ) {y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ y → (k < RankTransport.piLE y ↔ RankTransport.p k ≤ y)

RankTransport.GaussianCurve →
  RankTransport.SparseCurve →
    RankTransport.FlatCurve →
      ∀ {b e : ℝ},
        0 ≤ b →
          0 < e →
            ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              ∀ (j : ℕ),
                0 < j →
                  j ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ + 1 →
                    0 < RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n ∧
                      RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n <
                        Min.min (RankTransport.g b + e) (Min.min (RankTransport.sparse b) (RankTransport.flat b)) *
                          RankTransport.H (RankTransport.p n)
∀ (r : ℝ), RankTransport.flatStar r = (RankTransport.Af + RankTransport.Kf * r) / RankTransport.Df

∀ {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r →
    RankTransport.sparseStar r + 1 / 2000000 ≤ RankTransport.sparse r ∧
      RankTransport.flatStar r + 1 / 250 ≤ RankTransport.flat r
∀ {c : ℝ} (n j : ℕ), 0 < j → ¬n < n + j → False
∀ {d : ℝ}, 0 < d → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 2 ≤ d * √(RankTransport.p n)
∀ {a c d : ℝ}, RankTransport.Good a c → c ≤ d → RankTransport.Good a d

∀ (n : ℕ) {y : ℝ},
  RankTransport.p n ≤ y →
    RankTransport.piLT y - RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) =
      RankTransport.piLE y - RankTransport.piLE (RankTransport.p n) - if ↑⌊y⌋₊ = y ∧ Nat.Prime ⌊y⌋₊ then 1 else 0
∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), k < RankTransport.piLT y ↔ RankTransport.p k < y

∀ {b : ℝ},
  0 ≤ b →
    ∀ {w : ℝ → ℝ},
      Continuous w →
        (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 b, ∃ a c, r < a ∧ c < w r ∧ RankTransport.Good a c) →
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (j : ℕ),
              0 < j →
                j ≤ ⌊b * √(RankTransport.p n)⌋₊ + 1 →
                  0 < RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n ∧
                    RankTransport.p (n + j) - RankTransport.p n <
                      w ((↑j - 1) / √(RankTransport.p n)) * RankTransport.H (RankTransport.p n)

∀ {A D K : ℝ},
  0 ≤ A →
    0 < D →
      0 < K → RankTransport.BRLower A D K → ∀ {r e : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → 0 < e → RankTransport.Good r ((A + K * r) / D + e)
RankTransport.SharpFlat → ∀ {r e : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → 0 < e → RankTransport.Good r (RankTransport.flatStar r + e)
